verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers liveness, AML screening, reusable KYC (data sharing between consenting clients), and transaction anomaly detection, but none of these describe automatic detection of the same face or document resurfacing under different applicant identities. Missing for 10: any documentation of cross-applicant duplicate/repeat identity matching, facial similarity search across profiles, or fraud-ring detection linking multiple names to one biometric/document.
